I mean, you can hardly believe otherwise when you know that their mozz box player studied under the same mozz legend, Rem Yonka, as the Sozzenels' Xornu flux&mdash;I mean, Plox.|[[Ssorku]], on [[Hova Mensk and the Blurtones]]|<ref name="Horning In">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20020117a_horningin&c=rpg|text=Horning In|int=Horning In}}</ref>}}
'''Xornu Plox''' was a musician who was a member of the [[Jizz/Legends|jizz]] band [[the Sozzenels]]. Plox trained under the reputable [[mozz box]] player [[Rem Yonka]].
